name: B10-0044/2024 (S&D) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Cuba to release José Daniel Ferrer, a jailed dissident, and to confirm his health and let his family visit. It also asks Cuba to stop holding people for peaceful protest, to open a national dialogue, and urges the United States to lift its economic blockade of Cuba.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is a request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government, José Daniel Ferrer, and Cuban dissidents.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to Cuban authorities, the Council, the Commission and the EU foreign policy chief.
